channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
item.description: Asahi, Kirin and Suntory confirmed their premises were searched by Japanese competition authorities.

item.title: IMF chief concerned about high Japan and U.S. long-term rates
item.description: Kristalina Georgieva voiced concern that the 10-year Japanese government bond yield has reached its highest level in about 30 years.

item.title: Topix’s largest-ever overhaul to cull hundreds of Japan stocks
item.description: According Japan Exchange Group, there are 683 companies earmarked for removal under tougher Topix inclusion rules.

item.title: 12 years sought for attacker of anti-NHK group leader
item.description: According to the indictment, Miyanishi cut Tachibana's head with a machete on a sidewalk outside the industry ministry in Tokyo on March 14 last year.

item.title: Japanese scientist Kenso Soai and France’s Henri B. Kagan win Nobel Prize in chemistry
item.description: Japanese scientist Kenso Soai and Henri B. Kagan won "for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis."

item.title: Japanese city accused of inflating census as country's population shrinks
item.description: As a result, Toyama city may have received more funding from the central government than it should have.

item.title: 'Not again': Arrest of US marine for murder reignites protests in Japan's Okinawa
item.description: For many locals on this island, the arrest has brought decades of frustration back to the fore.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
